title: How would you describe this sound?
description: A listening study about the character of short synthesizer sounds.

descriptors.label: Brightness
descriptors.definition: How much high-frequency or treble character does this sound have?

descriptors.label: Roughness
descriptors.definition: How much rapid fluttering, beating or grating texture does this sound have?

descriptors.label: Percussiveness
descriptors.definition: How much does this sound resemble a struck or plucked event, with a distinct onset followed by a fall in sound level?

scale.unclear_label: I cannot judge / the term is unclear

experience_question.label: Give one example of making music or shaping a sound yourself.
experience_question.help: One short sentence is enough. Say what you did and which tool you used. Personal practice counts; it does not need to be released or professional work.
experience_question.placeholder: For example: I made a bass patch in Vital by adjusting the filter and envelope.

resume_instructions: You may close this tab and return to the same study link using the same browser profile on the same device while the study is open. Avoid private/incognito mode and do not clear this site's data. Your invitation starts one session; it cannot restore a session in a different browser. Each saved response is kept; an unfinished answer may need to be entered again.
information: You will listen to short synthesizer sounds and rate three aspects of their character. Some sounds may be presented more than once.
There are 3 practice sounds followed by the number of study presentations shown below. Allow about 15–20 minutes for the full pilot; this estimate will be checked in a rehearsal.
Participation is voluntary. You may stop or withdraw using the study controls. Use a comfortable volume and stop if listening becomes uncomfortable.
We store a participant code, your experience answers, sound ratings, playback counts and response times. Do not enter your name, email address or identifying links in free-text answers.
Responses are intended for this synth-timbre research and its research report. The study uses participant codes; it does not ask for your name. Hosting services may keep technical access logs.

You can withdraw this session's responses using the withdrawal control while you retain access on this browser. Withdrawal marks your responses as excluded from analysis. Researchers must describe any later data-retention or deletion arrangements before recruitment.

eligibility.rule: Adult volunteer reporting relevant practical experience and a brief example of a completed task. Exact criterion and acceptable evidence remain subject to supervisor confirmation.
